headline: Forest leave Ipswich with a point after dominant attacking display

sentences.text: Nott'm Forest had to settle for a 1–1 draw at Ipswich, but their attacking numbers offered plenty of encouragement.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, only for Julio Enciso to equalise before half-time; neither side scored after the break.
Forest registered 17 shots and 2.29 expected goals to Ipswich's 7 and 0.46, but could not turn that edge into a winner.
